families.studentsIntro: Connect families to your academy. Batch enrolment is a separate step.
families.copied: Link copied. Share it privately with the family.
families.copyFailed: Select the link and copy it using your browser.
families.inviteHelp: Single-use link, valid for 14 days. Share only with the intended parent. Reopen this link after sign-in.
families.unknownInvite: The invitation result is unconfirmed. Retry this same request. After reload, create a fresh invite if the original link is unavailable.
families.noAcademies: No academy available. Create an academy or ask its owner for access.
families.emptyRoster: No connected children on this page. Share an invite to get started.
families.joinIntro: Use your coach’s invitation to connect a child profile you created.
families.invalidLink: Open the complete invite link shared by your coach. Sign in first, then reopen it.
families.declaration: I confirm this is my child profile and I want to connect it to this academy.
families.connected: Connection saved. Batch enrolment is a separate step.
families.used: This invitation has already been accepted by your account.
families.ownProfiles: View or create your child profiles
families.noChildren: Create your child profile first, then reopen the invitation.
families.failed: Unable to complete this action. Check your session and access, then try again.
families.inviteFailed: Invitation unavailable. It may be expired, used, or no longer permitted. Ask your coach for a new link.
families.acceptUnknown: Connection result is unconfirmed. Keep this child selected and retry. You can reopen the original link to check again.
families.sessionChanged: Your session may have changed. Load again to continue.
families.monitorUnavailable: Session monitoring is unavailable. Reload to continue.
families.noConnections: No active academy connections for this child.
families.privacy: This confirms an academy connection only. It does not verify legal guardianship or grant media, fee or pickup permissions.

enrollments.title: Batch enrolment
enrollments.intro: Connect families first, then enrol each child into a saved batch.
enrollments.noBatches: No batches available for this academy.
enrollments.empty: No saved enrolments in this batch.
enrollments.failed: Unable to load enrolments. Refresh to try again.
enrollments.unknown: The enrolment reply is uncertain. Keep this page open and check its status before making another change.
enrollments.original: Sign in with the original account to check the unresolved enrolment.
enrollments.saved: Operation confirmed. The saved roster has been refreshed.
enrollments.unavailable: Session monitoring is unavailable. Enrolments cannot be loaded.
enrollments.classesIntro: Saved classes for your eligible child. An academy connection alone does not enrol a child.
enrollments.noChildren: No eligible children available for classes.
enrollments.noClasses: No saved classes for this child.
enrollments.classesFailed: Unable to load classes. Refresh to try again.
enrollments.conflict: This change was not saved because the enrolment changed or already exists. Review the current roster before choosing your next action.
